aha: The left piranha well holds exactly two stones and there are three: the stone hanging over the well (the obvious one to drop on the fish) must be left alone, and the two road stones go in, one pushed from each side.
deadlocks: Dropping the hanging stone into the left well: the well is then full after one more and the remaining road stone blocks the pearl.
Pushing the middle stone right into the gate well: it kills the piranha but lands on the gate.
Pushing the left pearl before both stones are in the well: it falls in and is stuck.
Standing next to the right well's mouth while its piranha comes up (eaten); the final dig there must be timed.
